patch_list: Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Turns off the sponsored product carousels, ad banners, and partner offers after checkout.
Stops Medallia survey invitations and the "rate the app" dialog on the home screen.
